causalInterventions.defect: A World Literature comparative-reading integrator failed lesson-kernel admission, leaving Lesson 8 missing and six quiz items on source-bound recovery.
causalInterventions.change: Recognize only genuine comparative-reading and comparative-essay integrators, copy disciplinary facts verbatim from earlier admitted assigned-text kernels, and preserve projection provenance.
causalInterventions.artifactDelta: World Literature moved from 89/B with one blocker and two P1 findings to 99/A with 14/14 admitted kernels, no recovery items, and zero findings.

causalInterventions.defect: The Mandarin brief requested fifteen lessons but named fourteen content clauses; model-authored splitting shifted identities, and an ASCII-only substantiveness counter ignored Hanzi in a valid grammar fact.
causalInterventions.change: Reconcile the exact contract through one bounded retrieval bridge and count Unicode letters/numbers when deciding whether admitted language evidence can support a teaching kernel.
causalInterventions.artifactDelta: Mandarin moved from 14/15 enrichment, one blocker, two retries, and 89/B to 15/15, zero retries, 99/A, and zero findings.

causalInterventions.defect: Psychology paired an earlier artifact term with a later focus cue and falsely reported prompt contamination; downstream artifact reconciliation compared rewritten titles but ignored exact assessment IDs.
causalInterventions.change: Require the focus cue to precede and remain near the artifact term, and resolve stable assessment IDs before display-title matching.
causalInterventions.artifactDelta: The false blocker and false missing-artifact warning disappear; the real browser package is 99/A with zero findings or flagged checks.

causalInterventions.defect: Quiz readability counted hidden blueprint and instructor-feedback metadata, while visible constructed-response directions used unnecessarily long sentences.
causalInterventions.change: Exclude non-rendered planning fields from learner-paper readability and shorten visible question, answer-guidance, sample-answer, rubric-hint, and scoring sentences.
causalInterventions.artifactDelta: The Psychology quiz grade-level warning disappears in the exported learner paper without hiding a visible field.

causalInterventions.defect: Five of six cross-concept exam frames implied concept selection and evidence boundaries but did not state both requirements explicitly.
causalInterventions.change: Every variant now requires independent concept selection, one distinct evidence detail per concept, an explicit relationship, and a limitation or unsupported extension.
causalInterventions.artifactDelta: Mandarin moves from 4/16 explicitly bounded short answers and one P2 to no constructed-response depth finding.

psychology.rootCause: false prompt-artifact contamination plus stable-assessment-ID reconciliation gap
